title: Survey Study for Velaglucerase Alfa (VPRIV) in Japan
brief_summary: The objective of this post-marketing survey study is to collect data to determine the safety and efficacy of velaglucerase alfa (VPRIV) in participants with Gaucher disease who are new to therapy or have been switched from another therapeutic agent for Gaucher disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female participants with a confirmed diagnosis of Gaucher disease
* Participants who are either naïve to treatment or participants that have been treated with another therapeutic agent for Gaucher disease
* Participants who start VPRIV treatment or transition from VPRIV clinical studies during the enrollment period

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
study_population: Participants with confirmed Gaucher disease (types 1, 2, or 3) irrespective of any age or gender who are either naïve to treatment or participants that have been treated with another therapeutic agent for Gaucher disease.
